This is today’s edition of The Download, our weekday newsletter that provides a daily dose of what’s going on in the world of technology. At the end of April, Anthropic claimed that its model Claude Mythos is better at finding software vulnerabilities than most security experts. Then we had the OpenAI–Hugging Face hacking incident, after which Anthropic (proudly) and Meta (reluctantly) disclosed similar incidents

Florida AG accuses teacher of labeling student a 'misogynist' over 'conservative views': 'She should be fired'. Florida Attorney General James Uthmeier alleges a Pine View School teacher bullied a conservative eighth grader and labeled him a "misogynist."

Texas man charged with capital murder after 5-year-old killed in roadway shooting. Jeremy Porter was charged with capital murder after police said he killed 5-year-old Zah'Layah Walter in a roadway shooting in northwest Harris County.

College basketball TV analyst and former Duke assistant Chris Spatola, Coach K's son-in-law, dies at 47. Chris Spatola - starting guard for the Army Black Knights and later coached under Mike Krzyzewski at Duke before joining ESPN's broadcast team has passed.

Caitlin Clark, Indiana Fever drop statement win on top-seeded Lynx in final home game. Caitlin Clark flirted with a triple-double as the Indiana Fever handed the league-best Minnesota Lynx their largest deficit of the season so far.

Ella Langley says 'Choosin' Texas' success is 'changing my life' after her song breaks Mariah Carey's record. Ella Langley celebrated a career-defining milestone after “Choosin’ Texas" spent its 23rd week at No. 1 on the Billboard Hot 100.

Harris keeps 2028 door open as she hits midterm campaign trail, warns ‘28 won’t matter’ without 2026. Kamala Harris told Detroit voters she has not decided on a 2028 presidential run, stressing that the 2026 midterm elections must come first.

Lukashenko reveals bizarre argument he and Putin have over who is the ‘bigger dictator’. Belarusian President Alexander Lukashenko told a youth forum that he and Vladimir Putin regularly argue over who is the bigger dictator.

‘Big Sister’ warning resurfaces as Massachusetts expands home visits after Clancy trial. Anne Schlafly says Massachusetts' Welcome Family nurse home visits echo her mother Phyllis Schlafly's 1999 "Big Sister" government warnings.

Kamala Harris says 'attack on DEI is an attack on maternal care' in appearance with El-Sayed. Harris also accused political leaders who promote “family values" of hypocrisy while supporting policies she said could worsen the maternal health crisis.

Former WWE star Kurt Angle says 'I believe that I had a better career in TNA'. Kurt Angle says his TNA Wrestling career was better than his WWE run, pointing to classic matches against Samoa Joe and AJ Styles as proof.

From Austin to New York, pro-China network fuels week of anti-US protests as Xi meets Trump. Pro-China groups funded by tech tycoon Neville Roy Singham stage protests from Austin to New York, N.Y., as Trump prepares for Xi Jinping talks.

El-Sayed mocked for 'word salad' answer when pressed by conservative on voting for him: 'Worse than Kamala's'. Abdul El-Sayed's town hall remarks referring to pregnant women as "adult or juvenile human" drew fierce backlash in the Michigan Senate race.

Violent brawl over lounge chairs at famous beach leaves one man dead, others facing charges. A deadly fight over lounge chairs at a Vouliagmeni beach near Athens, Greece, left an 82-year-old man dead after he went into cardiac arrest during the struggle.

Bunnie Xo responds to fan backlash over cozy outing with 24-year-old reality star. Bunnie Xo's Waffle House video with 24-year-old Dylan Wolf sparked an age gap debate, but she claims the outing wasn't a date and she's just having fun.

Super Bowl-winning coach reveals 'Cold War' with Broncos' Sean Payton over alleged spying | Matt Calkins. Mike Macdonald reveals Sean Payton "lost his mind" over Seahawks using fan-filmed Broncos practice plays from social media before their 2024 matchup.

DOJ defends White House media ban, urges court to reject lawsuit. The Department of Justice defended President Trump's recent media ban, arguing that reporting by CNN, MS Now and Politico on a wide range of issues jeopardized national security and spread falsehoods.

Major news outlets banned by Trump will have their day in court. CNN, MS NOW, and Politico are asking a federal judge to hold the president in check for what they say is a violation of their Constitutional rights simply because he doesn't like how they cover him.

There's growing concern that Trump may deploy the National Guard ahead of elections. Fears are growing that President Trump may deploy the U.S. military to polling places in the upcoming elections, despite strict state and federal laws against such a move.

How an 'AI freeze' could make big AI companies bigger and hurt smaller firms. Critics say a slowdown of AI development among the largest companies could consolidate the power of frontier labs, just as many others are trying to catch up.
ICE is looking into 'mobile detention facilities'. Buried in the paperwork for Immigration and Customs Enforcement's expansion in Pennsylvania is a document requesting "mobile detention facilities."

As Congress confronts AI, Senate lawmakers are shut off from its most advanced tools. While Senate offices have access to chatbots like ChatGPT, they are not authorized to use any of the more advanced tools that are at the center of regulatory talks and public debate about AI safety.

Poll: Trust in the U.S. Postal Service delivering mail-in ballots on time has fallen. Registered voters are less confident that USPS will deliver election mail on time compared with 2024, an NPR/PBS News/Marist poll finds, after USPS was part of Trump's bid to limit mail voting.

Poll: Most voters agree the 2026 midterms are all about Trump — and they disapprove. A new NPR/PBS News/Marist poll finds President Trump — and his unpopularity — is an outsize factor in why most voters say they want Democrats to win the midterms.

Category 5 Hurricane Polo is 'one of the strongest storms ever'. Hurricane Polo has grown into one of the most powerful Pacific cyclones in decades, and it was expected to skirt Mexico's southwestern coast as a Category 5 storm.

Trump administration to remove 760,000 Affordable Care Act enrollees over fraud claims. White House officials allege these individuals were fraudulently enrolled in the program or do not exist. Vice President Vance said the move would save $2.2 billion.
